limitations: iSTAND small (n=30), short (12 weeks), low-dose IVIG; albumin control may mask volume effects. Patient-selection (autoimmune POTS) limits generalizability. RECOVER IVIG is Long COVID OI, not idiopathic POTS. Prior off-target PMIDs removed. Not medical advice. Tracker Moderate label is not an OSMF A/B grade.
